pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with slightly rounded vertices. Edges exhibit a soft pixel gradient transition between dark and light regions. Patch area is maximal on the mid-flank and decreases in scale toward the ventral and shoulder regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way and four-way intersections. Pathway width is relatively uniform on the central flank but exhibits thinning and increased topological complexity near the neck-shoulder transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour along the upper neck mane. The silhouette against the background displays a consistent, fine-grained jaggedness.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A prominent structural discontinuity is visible in the mane line at the transition between the upper neck and the shoulder. The line is also locally interrupted by an avian silhouette perched on the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two avian organisms (oxpeckers) perched on the dorsal ridge and posterior flank, causing localized occlusion of the pelage pattern and dorsal silhouette.
